blocks.text: After your API subscription is enabled, the Digital Experience API Keys page is accessible to a ZDX admin. From there, the admin can provision and display available API keys.
If you must obtain API keys or secrets to access Zscaler OneAPI endpoints, see About API Clients.
The API Key Management page (Administration > API > Legacy API > Digital Experience API Keys) allows you to perform the following actions:

blocks.item: Name: Enter the API key name.
Select Role: Select an admin role to be assigned the API key.
Click Create Key to confirm, and the API Key window appears.
Click Copy to copy the API Key ID or Key Secret, or click Download to download the JSON file. You need both the API Key ID and Key Secret for authentication.
Click the View icon for a specific API key to open the API Key window.
Click Copy to copy the API Key ID.
Click the Edit icon for a specific API key to open the Edit API Key window.
Edit the Name or choose a new role from the Select Role drop-down menu.
Click Save to confirm the changes.
Click the Delete icon for a specific API key to open the Delete API Key window.
Click Delete to confirm the deletion.

blocks.text: To learn more, see About API Key Management.
